function.description: Returns device deployment status based on filter criteria.
function.name: api_getDeviceDeploymentStatus

networkDeviceId.description: Network device ID of the wired device to provision. The API /intent/api/v1/network-device can be used to get the network device ID.

configGroupName.description: Name of the config group that has been provisioned. example: application.telemetry

configGroupVersion.description: Version of the config group that has been provisioned. The version increments everytime for a provisioning operation.

createTime.description: Create time of the service deployment status record; as measured in Unix epoch time in milliseconds.

endTime.description: Service provisioning task end time; as measured in Unix epoch time in milliseconds.

message.description: A brief message about the error.example: Connection to device timedout

remedy.description: A brief message to suggest remedy to the failure. example: Upgrade the IOS version

lastUpdateTime.description: Last update time of the service deployment status record; as measured in Unix epoch time in milliseconds.

networkDeviceId.description: Network device ID of the wired device to provision. The API /intent/api/v1/network-device can be used to get the network device ID.

startTime.description: Service provisioning task start time; as measured in Unix epoch time in milliseconds.
